new_processes.name: Origination revenue recognition reconciliation
new_processes.definition: Reconciling origination amounts recognized by books against what other desks recorded, and tracing which book granted them.

new_processes.name: Accrual breakdown reporting
new_processes.definition: Sending daily breakdowns of accrued amounts by counterparty to logistics and accounting staff.

new_processes.name: Finalized transport invoice update
new_processes.definition: Updating Sitara deals after transport invoices are finalized for the month.

new_processes.name: Customer trip coordination
new_processes.definition: Organizing the annual customer trip: RSVPs, packing lists, agenda and travel guidance for account owners.

new_processes.name: Fuel retainage and fuel accounting
new_processes.definition: Deciding how fuel is retained, priced, nominated and booked in systems, and explaining differences between estimated and actual fuel.

new_processes.name: EOL product launch
new_processes.definition: Planning and setting up a new product type on the online trading platform, including legal terms and meetings between groups.

new_processes.name: NSS deal booking correction
new_processes.definition: Correcting how NSS transactions are booked and valued, with risk review of the proposed fix.

new_processes.name: Unfinaled invoice review
new_processes.definition: Circulating spreadsheets of unfinaled sales and purchase invoices so staff can flag discrepancies.
